action: the fire burning, flames leaping and flickering wildly with embers rising off it
the sickly yellow-green gas cloud billowing and roiling, swelling and thinning
the mud bubbling sluggishly, thick bubbles rising and bursting on the surface
the seed glowing brighter and dimmer in a steady pulse and turning slowly
the feed token turning slowly and catching the light with a soft warm pulse
the horseshoe magnet pulsing with a faint electric shimmer arcing between its poles
